g.text: How well does each team defend?

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #333333

g.text: One dot represents one team's score, where one team is one pair of defenders A and B trained corresponding to one seed. The black line is the mean of the teams that have a value; a team without one is not drawn. Lines are the rule baselines. An unfilled dot is the team before training,

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #333333

g.text: joined to its trained value. The grey panel shows the same rewards zoomed to the teams and the two teachers; a baseline outside it is named under it. Team reward per episode: over all episodes - denominator: number of episodes | B's infected server-intervals per intrusion episode:

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #333333
